description: Defines an abstract class 'Wrapper' used in code generation, managing context and variable references for different programming languages.

classes.name: Wrapper
classes.description: Abstract class used for code generation, managing language-specific contexts and variable references.

methods.name: getVariable
methods.description: Abstract method to return the BaseVariable this Wrapper represents.

methods.name: getSectionMask
methods.description: Returns the section mask indicating sections this wrapper is referenced by.

methods.name: getLanguageMask
methods.description: Returns the language mask indicating target languages for code generation.

methods.name: getContextJava
methods.description: Returns the Java context used during Java code generation.

methods.name: getContextNative
methods.description: Returns the native context used during C code generation.

methods.name: isInList
methods.description: Checks if the wrapper is part of a list (ArrayVariable).

methods.name: isInMap
methods.description: Checks if the wrapper is part of a map (MapVariable).

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the name of the variable if available, otherwise default string.
